issue: Lock-order inversion among four official sacramental seat RPCs: two obtained parish_parameters FOR UPDATE before pending rows; two previously obtained pending first.
mitigation: Early parish_parameters SELECT FOR UPDATE added before pending row reads in seat_pending_marriage(uuid) and seat_funeral_record(jsonb,uuid); existing logic unchanged; rollback definitions captured.
limitations: No true two-backend overlapping sessions with valid independent credentials; dblink refused passwordless self connection (2F003).
No observed deadlock reproduction. pg_stat_database reports 0 historical deadlocks, but cannot prove absence of future deadlocks.
No production role changes or historical sacrament mutations; dummy records only in rolled-back transactions.
Do not approve 07.03 or 07.08 based on these tests.
